tokenizer.id: llama.cpp worker b0-live-llama-worker1 via gateway /v1/tokenize (alias engineering/b0)
tokenizer.method: POST /v1/tokenize with one user message; referenceTokens = prompt_tokens minus templateOverheadTokens (prompt_tokens for an empty message)
tokenizer.note: All referenceTokens values below were measured on this worker. None are taken from another tokenizer.

corpora.name: english prose (200 words)
repeat: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

corpora.name: CJK 16-char classical x 25
repeat: 天地玄黄宇宙洪荒日月盈昃辰宿列张

corpora.name: CJK 7-char sentences x 50
corpora.note: DEC-17: REQ-AGT-118's >= 1 token per CJK char floor forces 400 tokens; this tokenizer merges common words to 200. Over-estimate 2.00x is an admission-safety bias (never an under-estimate; not an accuracy claim), outside the ACC-VER-07 1.5x band by design.

corpora.name: Kana 200 chars
repeat: あいうえおかきくけこ

corpora.name: Hangul 200 chars
corpora.note: DEC-17: REQ-AGT-118's >= 1 token per Hangul char floor forces 200 tokens; this tokenizer gives 120. Over-estimate 1.67x is an admission-safety bias (not an accuracy claim), outside the ACC-VER-07 1.5x band by design.
